measures.name: Selected Year Label
measures.expression:
VAR SelectedCount = COUNTROWS(VALUES(bi_year_filter[year]))
VAR AllCount = COUNTROWS(ALL(bi_year_filter))
RETURN SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    SelectedCount = 0, "No years",
    SelectedCount = 1, FORMAT(SELECTEDVALUE(bi_year_filter[year]), "0"),
    SelectedCount = AllCount, "All years",
    "Multiple years"
)
measures.description: Calendar-year selection: no years, one year, all years in the dimension, or multiple selected years. All-year comparison clears the entire year dimension; a subset is never labeled All years.

measures.name: Selected State Label
measures.expression:
VAR SelectedCount = COUNTROWS(VALUES(bi_state_filter[state_name]))
VAR AllCount = COUNTROWS(ALL(bi_state_filter))
RETURN SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    SelectedCount = 0, "No states",
    SelectedCount = 1, SELECTEDVALUE(bi_state_filter[state_name]),
    SelectedCount = AllCount, "All states",
    "Multiple states"
)
measures.description: Project-state selection: no states, one state, all states in the dimension, or multiple selected states. All-state comparison clears the entire state dimension, including region; a regional subset is never labeled All states.

measures.name: Approval Dollars
measures.description: Nominal reported approval amounts: whole 7(a) loans plus the SBA/Certified Development Company portion of 504 loans. Includes canceled/not-funded approval records; not disbursements or total project financing. Selected geography and calendar years apply; unrelated program, industry and lender-name slicers do not filter these state/year components.

measures.name: Approval Records

Selected geography and calendar years apply; unrelated program, industry and lender-name slicers do not filter these state/year components.

measures.name: Known Industry Dollar Share

The denominator removes the industry dimension filter; unknown/unclassified sectors are excluded from both sides. Show Industry Dollar Coverage alongside it. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Industry Dollar Coverage
measures.description: Known-sector reported amounts divided by all reported amounts in selected geography and calendar years. Clears the industry dimension and known-only page flag for the all-industry denominator; unknown/unclassified amounts stay in that denominator. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.display_name: Amounts with a known lender name (%)
measures.description: Known reporting-name amounts divided by all reported approval amounts in selected geography and calendar years. Independent of the individual lender-name selection. Classification coverage does not establish resolved banking identity. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Selected Top Five Known Lender Share
measures.expression:
VAR Lenders =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        ADDCOLUMNS(
            SUMMARIZE(bi_lender_mix, bi_lender_mix[lender_key]),
            "__Amount", CALCULATE(SUM(bi_lender_mix[total_approved_loan_amount]))
        ),
        REMOVEFILTERS(bi_lender_filter)
    )
VAR TopFive = TOPN(5, Lenders, [__Amount], DESC, bi_lender_mix[lender_key], ASC)
RETURN DIVIDE(SUMX(TopFive, [__Amount]), SUMX(Lenders, [__Amount]))
measures.description: Aggregate known-name reported amounts across selected states and years, then rank the five largest names. Denominator is all known-name amounts; the lender-name selection is removed. Names reflect currently assigned 7(a) banks and reported 504 third-party lenders, not resolved historical institutions. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.
measures.display_name: Five largest names: share of known-name amounts

measures.name: Pooled State Year Top Five Share
measures.description: Sum of stored state/year top-five reported amounts divided by all known-name amounts in selected geography and years. Membership varies by state/year; this is not the share of five names ranked over the entire selection. The lender-name selection does not filter these state/year components. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Approvals per 1000 Establishment Years
measures.display_name: Approval records per 1,000 employer locations per year
measures.description: Same-year approval records per 1,000 Census employer business locations across firm sizes. For several years, summed annual stocks form establishment-years, not unique business counts. Both components use the same matched state/year population. Context only; not credit access or market penetration. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Approval Dollars per Establishment Year
measures.display_name: Reported amounts per employer location per year
measures.description: Reported nominal approval amounts divided by Census employer-location stocks on the same matched state/year rows. Selected geography and years apply. One year gives dollars per employer location; several years sum annual stocks as establishment-years. Employer locations cover all firm sizes and exclude nonemployers; this is context, not credit access. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Comparable Full Year Dollar Growth
measures.expression:
VAR SelectedYear = SELECTEDVALUE(bi_year_filter[year])
VAR CurrentStates = VALUES(bi_state_lending_trends[state_key])
VAR PriorStates =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(bi_state_lending_trends[state_key]),
        REMOVEFILTERS(bi_year_filter),
        bi_year_filter[year] = SelectedYear - 1
    )
RETURN IF(
    HASONEVALUE(bi_year_filter[year]) &&
    COUNTROWS(EXCEPT(CurrentStates, PriorStates)) = 0 &&
    COUNTROWS(EXCEPT(PriorStates, CurrentStates)) = 0 &&
    COUNTROWS(bi_state_lending_trends) = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(bi_state_lending_trends), bi_state_lending_trends[is_comparable_yoy] = TRUE()),
    DIVIDE(SUM(bi_state_lending_trends[total_approved_loan_amount]) - SUM(bi_state_lending_trends[comparable_prior_year_amount]), SUM(bi_state_lending_trends[comparable_prior_year_amount]))
)
measures.display_name: Reported amount change from previous full year
measures.description: Change in nominal reported approval amounts divided by the prior full-year amount, preserving selected geography. Returns blank for multiple/no selected years, partial or noncomparable periods, differing observed state populations in either direction, or a zero/unknown prior denominator. An absent state is not zero activity.

measures.name: Chargeoff Dollar Rate
measures.description: Reported gross chargeoff amounts divided by nominal reported approval amounts in selected geography and years. These are observed historical statuses and amounts at the saved snapshot, not vintage-adjusted credit loss, default probability or comparable SBA exposure. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Charged Off Record Share
measures.description: Records with a reported chargeoff divided by all eligible approval records in selected geography and years. Observed historical status at the saved snapshot, not vintage-adjusted loss or a credit-risk estimate. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Term Coverage
measures.description: Records with a valid known term divided by all eligible approval records in selected geography and years. Invalid negative or missing terms are unknown; known zero terms count as available. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Average Known Term Months
measures.description: Sum of valid term months divided by the known-term record count in selected geography and years. Unknown terms do not become zero; never average stored group means. Display Term Coverage alongside it. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Initial Rate Coverage
measures.display_name: Records with a known initial rate (%)
measures.description: Records with a valid known initial interest rate divided by all eligible approval records in selected geography and years. Missing/invalid negative rates are unknown; known zero rates count as available. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Average Known Initial Rate
measures.description: Sum of valid initial interest rates divided by the known-rate record count in selected geography and years. Unknown rates do not become zero; never average stored group means. Display Initial Rate Coverage alongside it. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Fixed Interest Share
measures.display_name: Fixed-rate share of recognized rate types
measures.description: Recognized fixed-rate records divided by all recognized fixed/variable rate-type records in selected geography and years. Unknown rate types are excluded from the denominator. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Variable Interest Share
measures.display_name: Variable-rate share of recognized rate types
measures.description: Recognized variable-rate records divided by all recognized fixed/variable rate-type records in selected geography and years. Unknown rate types are excluded from the denominator. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: 7a Guarantee Rate
measures.description: SBA guaranteed amount divided by whole-loan amount on the same 7(a) records with both amounts known. Show approval-and-guarantee coverage alongside it. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Known 504 Third Party to SBA Amount Ratio
measures.description: Third-party dollars divided by the SBA/CDC portion on the same 504 records with both amounts known. This can exceed 100% because the denominator is only part of financing. Show the records-with-both-amounts-known coverage alongside it. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Jobs Coverage
measures.description: Records with valid reported jobs divided by all eligible approval records in selected geography and years. Known zero counts as available; missing/invalid negative jobs remain unknown. Values are lender estimates of created/retained positions at application, not audited or causal outcomes. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Reported Jobs per Known Record
measures.display_name: Reported jobs per record with jobs known
measures.description: Sum of reported jobs divided by records with known jobs in selected geography and years; unknown jobs do not become zero. Display Jobs Coverage alongside it. Jobs are lender estimates of created/retained positions at application, not audited or causal outcomes. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Reported Jobs per Million Approved
measures.display_name: Reported jobs per $1 million in approval amounts
measures.description: Sum of known reported jobs times one million divided by all nominal reported approval amounts in selected geography and years. The dollar denominator includes records with unknown jobs; show Jobs Coverage. Jobs are lender estimates at application, not audited or causal outcomes. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Approved Dollars per Reported Job
measures.display_name: Reported approval amounts per reported job
measures.description: All nominal reported approval amounts divided by the sum of known reported jobs in selected geography and years. Includes approval amounts on records with unknown jobs; show Jobs Coverage. Jobs are lender estimates at application, not audited or causal outcomes. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Status Dollar Share
measures.display_name: Status share of reported approval amounts
measures.description: Selected reported loan-status amounts divided by all-status amounts in the same geography and years. The denominator clears status key, label and sort-order filters only. Statuses are observed at the saved snapshot; amounts remain nominal approvals including canceled/not-funded records. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: Reported Jobs per Approval Record
measures.description: Sum of known reported jobs divided by all eligible approval records in selected geography and years, including records with unknown jobs. Show Jobs Coverage; this differs from the known-record mean. Jobs are lender estimates at application, not audited or causal outcomes. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.

measures.name: State Mean Monthly SA Unemployment Rate
measures.display_name: State unemployment: mean monthly adjusted rate
measures.description: Mean of available monthly seasonally adjusted rates for one state and one year. Not an official weighted annual or national rate. Show month coverage; October 2025 was not published. Returns blank for multiple states or years.

measures.name: State Unemployment Change PP
measures.description: Change between comparable full annual state means, in percentage points: 4% to 5% is +1 point. Partial or publisher-omitted years have no comparable change. Returns blank for multiple states or years.

measures.name: State Published Establishment Entry Rate
measures.description: Census published entry rate for one state and one year; non-additive. Uses entries over the mean of scope-consistent current and derived prior employer-location stocks. Returns blank for multiple/no states or years, absent source values or conflicting rows. Do not sum or average state/year rates.

measures.name: State Published Establishment Exit Rate
measures.description: Census published exit rate for one state and one year; non-additive. Uses exits over the mean of scope-consistent current and derived prior employer-location stocks. Returns blank for multiple/no states or years, absent source values or conflicting rows. Do not sum or average state/year rates.

measures.name: Selected Known Source Name Count
measures.display_name: Number of known reporting lender names
measures.description: Distinct normalized reporting-name keys with records in selected geography and calendar years, ignoring the individual lender-name selection. These are currently assigned 7(a) banks and reported 504 third-party lenders, not resolved historical institutions or banking groups.

measures.name: Approval Amount Coverage
measures.description: Share of eligible approval records with a valid reported amount; zero amounts are known. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.
measures.display_name: Records with a known approval amount (%)

measures.name: 504 Paired Financing Coverage
measures.description: Share of eligible 504 records with both reported third-party and SBA/CDC amounts. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.
measures.display_name: 504 records with both financing amounts known (%)

measures.name: 7a Paired Guarantee Coverage
measures.display_name: 7(a) records with approval and guarantee amounts known (%)
measures.description: 7(a) records with both a valid whole-loan approval amount and SBA guaranteed amount divided by all eligible 7(a) records in selected geography and years. Missing/invalid values in either field are excluded from the numerator; known zeros remain valid. Returns blank for a zero or unknown denominator.
